div.p: Supralinear stokes in the digital edition actually correspond to supralinear dots on the papyrus (unless otherwise specified).

div.note: This text has not been added to papyri.info yet.

item.p: The supralinear stroke in ⲡⲣⲟⲧⲟⲛ resembles a circumflex. The omicrons in ϩⲩⲡⲟⲡⲟⲧⲓⲱⲛ appear in superscript.
In ϩⲓⲧⲛ a clear superlinear stroke is visible.
The supralinear stroke in ϩⲛⲧϭⲟⲙ resembles a circumflex.
Each group of three crosses appears above the preceding word. In ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲱ, the omega is placed above the iota, even though the word is not abbreviated.
